zh: 我下个月打算搬到新公寓。
old_en: I'm going to move into a new apartment next month.
new_en: I'm going to move into a new apartment next month.

zh: 今晚我打算早点睡，明天要早起。
old_en: I'm going to bed early tonight so I can get up early tomorrow.
new_en: I'm going to bed early tonight so I can get up early tomorrow.

zh: 今晚我准备十点就睡，最近太累了。
old_en: I'm going to bed at ten tonight because I've been really tired lately.
new_en: I'm going to bed at ten tonight because I've been really tired lately.

zh: 我打算下周开始学吉他。
old_en: I'm going to start learning guitar next week.
new_en: I'm going to start learning guitar next week.

zh: 下周我准备报一个吉他班，先学基础。
old_en: I'm going to sign up for a guitar class next week to learn the basics.
new_en: I'm going to sign up for a guitar class next week to learn the basics.

zh: 这个假期我们打算去爬山。
old_en: We're going to go hiking this vacation.
new_en: We're going to go hiking this vacation.

zh: 这个假期我计划去爬山，已经订好了车票。
old_en: We're going to go hiking this vacation and I've already booked our tickets.
new_en: I plan to go hiking this vacation and have already booked the tickets.

zh: 今年我计划存钱买一辆自行车，上班可以骑。
old_en: This year, I'm going to save money to buy a bike for commuting.
new_en: This year, I plan to save money to buy a bike for work.

zh: 下周末我打算请朋友吃饭。
old_en: I'm going to invite my friends to dinner next weekend.
new_en: Next weekend, I plan to have dinner with friends.

zh: 我们打算下个月搬到新公寓，离公司更近。
old_en: We're going to move to a new apartment next month, closer to the office.
new_en: We plan to move to a new apartment next month, closer to the office.

zh: 这个周末我准备去看一个朋友。
old_en: This weekend, I'm going to see a friend.
new_en: This weekend, I plan to visit a friend.

zh: 我打算这个周末去看朋友，顺便住一晚。
old_en: I'm going to visit a friend this weekend and stay overnight.
new_en: This weekend, I plan to visit a friend and stay overnight.

zh: 明年我打算换一份工作。
old_en: Next year, I'm going to switch jobs.
new_en: Next year, I'm going to switch jobs.

zh: 明年我计划换一份工作，想试试新的行业。
old_en: Next year, I'm going to switch jobs and try a new industry.
new_en: Next year, I'm going to switch jobs and try a new field.

zh: 我打算下个月买一台新电脑。
old_en: I'm going to buy a new computer next month.
new_en: I'm going to buy a new computer next month.

zh: 下个月我准备买一台新电脑，旧的太慢了。
old_en: Next month I'm going to buy a new computer because the old one is too slow.
new_en: Next month, I'm going to buy a new computer because my old one is too slow.

zh: 我明天下午打算去理发。
old_en: I'm going to get a haircut this afternoon tomorrow.
new_en: I'm going to get a haircut this afternoon.

zh: 明天下午我准备去理发，头发太长了。
old_en: I'm going to get a haircut because my hair is too long.
new_en: I'm going to get a haircut this afternoon because my hair is too long.

zh: 今年我打算存钱买一辆自行车。
old_en: I'm going to save money this year to buy a bike.
new_en: I'm going to save money this year to buy a bike.

zh: 我准备下周末请朋友吃饭，庆祝他找到工作。
old_en: I'm going to invite friends for dinner next weekend to celebrate their job.
new_en: I'm going to have dinner with friends next weekend to celebrate their new job.
